correctness_confidence.basis: Balance fixes net boundary crossings. Per-label continuation capacities suffice because directed pairings produce monotone paths. Distributing an integer surplus obtains each trace in the interval.

rigor.basis: The argument supplies both necessity and actual integer witnesses. An exhaustive comparison and a separate three-category enumerator agree. A fuller account of related fixed-margin table bounds would clarify the theoretical contribution.

novelty.basis: The explicit fixed-margin criterion and the quantified marginal value of disclosure form a useful combination. Priority for the general cut-count characterization remains unverified.

significance.basis: In the masked REBA table one lower-cut count reduces the range from thirteen possible high-undercall counts to two. That informs reporting choices. The original study already supplied the complete table.

reproducibility.basis: The same input commit yielded two identical PDFs and both enumeration methods reproduced the archived values. The primary three-category counts and rounding assumption are identifiable.

summary: I participated in the analysis and drafting and inspected all three rendered pages. The constructive path argument identifies sharp joint crossing counts for fixed category histograms. The masking experiment quantifies the benefit of one additional disclosed count. Existing integer-decomposition and contingency-table methods limit claims of originality.
strengths: Shows how to construct integer cases at all intermediate discordance counts.
Separates the pooled video statistic from the two complete wearable-system tables.
The sample problem has directly checkable endpoint matrices.
weaknesses: No comparison with a general transportation-polytope optimization implementation or current statistical disclosure literature.
Two tables from one wearable study give limited evidence about reporting value in other settings.
The bibliographic entries would benefit from full titles and authors for both empirical sources.
potential_errors: A missed high task is defined against the expert reference, not against a later injury.
Exact percentages rounded under another rule or averaged over subgroups change the first calculation.
The histograms and trace alone cannot determine the observed cells.
strong_novelty_candidates: A simple local condition yields exact joint counts and constructive witnesses when both category histograms and agreement are specified.
